VOICE_SUBTITLE: One voice for everyone, or a voice each person keeps.
SPEED_SUBTITLE: Milliseconds per letter; lower talks faster.
MAX_LETTERS_SUBTITLE: Longer messages are cut off after this many letters.
COOLDOWN_SUBTITLE: The least time between two messages read aloud, so a busy chat doesn't babble nonstop.
OWN_SUBTITLE: Read your own messages aloud too.
